name: ai-docent
description: Six multi-session tutor courses that take you from Claude beginner to power user: foundations, prompt craft, reliability, security, cost mechanics, and building with the API. Each runs an onboarding wizard, builds a personalized plan, and saves your progress between sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-session tutor courses for learning Claude
interface.longDescription: Six courses covering fundamentals, prompt craft, reliability, security, cost, and building with the API. Each is a multi-session tutor: it interviews you, builds a lesson plan around your real work, gates levels behind boss fights, and writes a progress card you can resume from.
